Priya (CS): HelixCare pilot in AP-SOUTH on 2026-03-28. Staging hit rate limits during rehearsal. Customer asks temporary QPS bump + CIDR allowlist for demo. Renewal touchpoint in 5 weeks; flagged high priority. Request: org_helix_77 qps 150->700, CIDR 203.0.114.0/24, start 2026-03-28T02:00Z, duration 36h, autorevoke 48h. Can netops + security review? :eyes:

Liam (SE): Copy. What traffic profile? Sustained or bursts? Model sizes?

Priya (CS): Mostly chat completions, avg 200 tokens, bursty: spikes to ~700 RPS for 10-30m. Will originate from ap-south-1 only. They confirm static egress range above.

Ethan (NetOps): I can add CIDR and temp rule. Need ticket and explicit start/end times. Also suggest canary at 250qps first, monitor 15m, then open to 700 if stable.

Maya (Security): Prefer header signing (X-Partner-Sig) if they can. If CIDR is required, limit to exact /24 and add strict anomaly alerts.

Priya (CS): They've agreed to send HMAC header. I'll add that to the ticket. I'll include renewal note and AM contact.

Ethan (NetOps): Opening INC-5489: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5489 
Description: HelixCare AP-SOUTH demo - temp QPS bump + CIDR allowlist. ETA config apply ~15m once HMAC provided.

deploy-bot: Queued policy: org=org_helix_77 qps=700 duration=36h autorevoke=48h allowlist=[203.0.114.0/24] region=ap-south-1 notes=[HMAC recommended]

Ethan (NetOps): Rules applied to ap-south edge. INC-5489 updated. Canary 250qps live. Please validate traffic during rehearsal.

Liam (SE): Canary looks stable after 12m. p95 latency 0.42s, 5xx=0. Promoting to demo window cap 700 qps.

Priya (CS): Thanks team 389; demo scheduled and AM looped for renewal talk. Will monitor and follow up after pilot.
